summary: Guide AI adoption, role redesign, and workforce wellbeing with executive-focused AI leadership training. Explore the course outline.
lede: AI-augmented workplace leadership helps senior leaders make accountable AI adoption and role-design decisions while supporting affected employees. For department heads and others responsible for AI adoption, the course develops practical ways to map task impacts, identify skills gaps, and strengthen human oversight and workforce wellbeing. Exercises include creating a role-impact map, a skills-transition matrix, and an executive decision brief.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders responsible for AI adoption decisions and the people whose roles, skills, and working conditions those decisions affect.
outcomes: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have responsibility for, or direct exposure to, organizational leadership, workforce planning, digital change, or AI adoption decisions. No coding or programming is required. Advanced AI governance and management-system concepts are introduced for executive-level operational discussion; the course does not teach technical implementation or certification preparation.
